sentences.text:
Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.,Nishant Dwivedi Hon'ble Ashwani Kumar Mishra,J.
Hon'ble Vinod Diwakar,J.

This writ petition has been filed with the prayer to quash the First Information Report registered as Case Crime No.0002 of 2023, under Sections 498A, 323 IPC and 3/4 of D.P. Act, Police Station Mahila Thana, District Etah.
Contention is that the petitioner is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the present case.
Learned A.G.A. opposes the prayer made in the writ petition.

We have perused the First Information Report, which prima facie discloses commissioning of cognizable offence and the prayer made to quash the F.I.R. otherwise cannot be entertained in view Manpal Singh And 3 Others vs State Of U.P.
